original: evaṃ pūrvaṃ yavaprayoge śrīhiśāstrasya svārthānuṣṭhāpakatvalakṣaṇaṃ yatprāmāṇyaṃ tatparityāgaḥ | ananuṣṭhāpakatvalakṣaṇaṃ yadaprāmāṇyaṃ tatsvīkāraḥ | punardvitīyaprayoge trīdyanuṣṭhāne vrīhiśāstrasya tyaktaprāmāṇyasvīkāraḥ | svīkṛtāprāmāṇyaparityāgaśceti trīhiśāstre catvāro doṣāḥ ityaṣṭadoṣaduṣṭo vikalpaḥ | sa ca vikalpaḥ kvacidekārthatvāt ;

original: atra pūrvaṃ karma kiṃcidapi saṃnihitaṃ na bhavati apūrvakarmasaṃnidhānarūpātprakaraṇāntarātprasiddhāgnihotradharmakaṃ tannāmakaṃ karmāntaraṃ vidhīyate | natvagnihotraśabdena prasiddhāgnihotramanūdya guṇavidhiḥ | prāpte karmaṇi ānantaryamāsarūpānekaguṇavidhau vākyabhedā | patteriti prakaraṇāntarādatra karmabhedaḥ |

original: prameyavicāraḥ

analyzed: atha prameya ādi vicāraḥ tatra veda ādi prameya ūrthaḥ trividhaḥ kratu arthaḥ puruṣa arthaḥ ubhaya arthayā iti tatra prayāja ādikam kevalam kratu arthaḥ phalam tad karaṇam ca puruṣa arthaḥ yathā jyotiṣṭoma ādiḥ svargaḥ ca

original: dadhyādi tūbhayarūpaṃ -- 'dadhnā juhuyāt' iti phalāsaṃyuktavākyena tvarthatvāt 'danendriyakāmasya juhuyāt' ityanena phalāya vidhānātpuruṣārthatvāt | taduktaṃ -- 'ekasya tūbhayarūpatve saṃyogapṛthaktvam' iti | saṃyogo vākyaṃ tasya pṛthaktvaṃ bhedaḥ | sa caikasya ubhayārthatve niyāmaka ityarthaḥ |

original: prayojakatvavicāraḥ

analyzed: katu arthe prayāja ādau ṛtuḥ prayojakaḥ puruṣa arthe phalam prayojakam prayojaka tvam nāma anuṣṭhāpaka tvam iti arthaḥ vidhiḥ yad artham yat anuṣṭhāpayati sa tatra prayojakaḥ darśa ādi vidhiḥ svarga artham darśa ādikam anuṣṭhāpayati iti svarga ādiḥ darśa ādau prayojakaḥ prayāja ādi vidhiḥ prayājān darśa ādi artham anuṣṭhāpayati iti darśa ādiḥ prayājānām prayojakaḥ

original: dadhyānayanavidhiḥ dadhyānayanamāmikṣārthamanuṣṭhāpayati, na vājinārtham | āmikṣārthaṃ dadhyānayanānuṣṭhāne sati vājinasya svataḥ -- siddhatvāt |

original: ata āmikṣaiva dadhyānayane prayojikā, na vājinam |' 'puroḍāśakapālena tuṣānupavapati' iti tuṣopavāpāṅgatvena puroḍāśakapālaṃ vidhīyate, tathāpi tuṣopavāpaḥ kapālasya prayojako na bhavati, puroḍāśārthamupāttenaiva kapālena tuṣopavāpasiddheḥ, kiṃtu puroḍāśa eva kapālasya prayojaka ityādyūhyam | iti prameyādinirūpaṇam ||

original: kramanirūpaṇam

original: śrutikramaḥ

original: arthakramaḥ

original: pāṭhakramaḥ 'samidho yajati', 'tanūnapātaṃ yajati' ityādau vidhivākyapāṭhakamādeva samidādiyāgānuṣṭhānakramaḥ |

analyzed: sthāna kramaḥ tathā jyotiṣṭome aupavasathyam ahar ārabhya krameṇa anuṣṭheyānām amīṣomīya savanīya anubandhyānām paśūnām trayāṇām sādyaska ākhye somayāge saha paśūn ālabheta iti ekadā anuṣṭhāna lakṣaṇam sāhityam bodhitam tat api yasya sthāne vihitam

original: mukhyakramaḥ

original: tathā darśe sāṃnāyyadharmāṇāṃ śākhācchedādīnāṃ pūrvam, āgneyadharmāṇāṃ nirvāpādīnāṃ ca anantaraṃ pravṛttāvapi mukhyayorāmeyasāṃnāyyayāgayomadhye āgneyayāgasya pūrvamanuṣṭhānānmukhyayāgakrameṇādāvāgneya puroḍāśasya prayojaśeṣābhighāraṇam, tataḥ payaso'bhighāraṇam iti mukhyayāgakramādabhighāraṇakramaḥ |

original: pravṛttikramaḥ

original: katham -- prakṛtāvanīṣomīyapaśorekatvena upakaraṇamādau kṛtvā dvitīyakṣaṇa evaṃ niyojanam, tṛtīyakṣaṇa evaṃ prokṣaṇam, vyavadhānaprayojakābhāvāt | atra tu saptadaśapaśūnāṃ sahānuṣṭheyatvavacanātprathamato yatra kvacitpaśau kṛtamupākaraṇaṃ svāśrayakartavyaniyojanāya ṣoḍaśabhiḥ kṣaṇairvyavadhānaṃ sahate, na tvadhikam |
analyzed: katham prakṛtau anīṣomīya paśoḥ ekatvena upakaraṇam ādau kṛtvā dvitīya kṣaṇe evam niyojanam tṛtīya kṣaṇe evam prokṣaṇam vyavadhāna prayojaka abhāvāt atra tu saptadaśa paśūnām saha anuṣṭheya tva vacanāt prathamatas yatra kvacid paśau kṛtam upākaraṇam sva āśraya kartavya niyojanāya ṣoḍaśabhiḥ kṣaṇaiḥ vyavadhānam sahate na tu adhikam

original: tatropākaraṇakrameṇa niyojanaṃ prathamapaśāvakṛtvā paśvantare niyojanaṃ kṛtvā'nantaraṃ prathamapaśau niyojanakaraṇe ṣoḍaśakṣaṇādhikakṣaṇavyavadhānaṃ śāstrānanumatamāpadyeta | tannirāsāyopākaraṇaṃ yena krameṇa pravṛttaṃ tenaiva niyojanādikaṃ kāryamiti pravṛttiṃkramaḥ | ityevaṃ śrutyarthapāṭhasthānamukhyapravṛttikramaireva karmānuṣṭhānam |
